title: Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Matun
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in [Berakhot 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.7b.16): “It was also taught so: Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Matun says: It is permitted to provoke the wicked in this world.” But in [Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:29](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Derekh_Eretz_Rabbah.2.29), the statement is attributed to Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yehudah.

In [Yoma 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.30b.8), Rabbi Dostai bar Matun speaks in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman calls Dostai a scribal error and proposes Rabbi Yustai bar Matun, as in [Zevachim 99](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.99a.16). He reports the same reading in Dikdukei Soferim on Berakhot 7b.

notes.text: The consulted Yoma 30b reads Dostai bar Matun, whereas Zevachim 99a reads Yostai son of Rabbi Matun. Hyman’s proposed correction and his report of the Dikdukei Soferim reading remain his; that exact edition was not directly inspected.
